Name: Cancelled Status Handling
Description: Verify display state and interactive check-in controls for cancelled time slots
Precondition: Appointment has been marked as Cancelled but originally scheduled time hour has not elapsed yet.
Test Step Description: Locate the cancelled schedule rows block item card container.
Test Step Expected Result: Portal displays the explicit status as Cancelled and blocks/disables UI interaction loops for online check-in operations.

Name: Edge - Leap Year Handling
Description: Verify schedule parser accurately handles edge leap dates without layout corruption
Test Step Description: View appointment card details inside the calendar rendering layout.
Test Step Expected Result: System displays the leap date 'February 29, 2028' cleanly without structural system calculations shifting dates forward to March.

Name: No Appointments Layout
Description: Verify standard text message visualization when patient has zero upcoming appointments
Precondition: Target profile is verified to have zero upcoming rows populated.
Test Step Description: Open the 'My Appointments' page directory link.
Test Step Expected Result: System gracefully displays flat textual context string reading exactly: 'You have no upcoming appointments.'

Name: Negative - Inactive Enrollment
Description: Verify claim is rejected if patient enrollment status is inactive
Test Step Expected Result: Adjudication engine immediately rejects claim with denial code 'ERR-ENR-01' (Inactive Enrollment).
